findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 22 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 19 questions numbered 1-19; by section: 22.1 1, 22.2 2, 22.3 3, 22.4 6, 22.5 1, 22.6 6.

Theory parts cover the classification of alcohols, acidity of alcohols and of phenol, the six syntheses of alcohols, the reactions of alcohols (combustion, substitution, sodium, oxidation and the dichromate test, dehydration), the preparation of phenol from phenylamine, reactions of the -OH group of phenol, activation of the ring with bromination, 1-naphthol, and an alcohol/phenol comparison. Numericals (heat of combustion of ethanol, ethene + steam, H₂ from sodium with ethanol and with phenol, bromination of phenol) use new values with molar masses given in the questions, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed (R alkyl, potassium dichromate(VI), breathalyser electrons released, phenol from diazonium salt + water, balanced 2 phenol + 2Na, phenyl ethanoate is an ester). None repeats the exercise's descriptive questions.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
